item.title: Kostecki claims rain-shortened Adelaide opener as Kiwi contingent stands strong, Wood finishes on podium - VelocityNews
item.description: Kiwi drivers starred in a rain-soaked opening day of the Supercars Adelaide Grand Final, as Brodie Kostecki won a dramatic Race 33 and the title fight tightened.

item.title: Feeney claims crucial Adelaide Victory while Wood aids Mostert and holds onto podium - VelocityNews
item.description: Broc Feeney secured a dominant win in Adelaide, with Ryan Wood playing a team role to let Chaz Mostert finish second, while Wood still claimed a podium finish in a thrilling Supercars opener.

item.title: Piastri wins Qatar Sprint as Lawson finishes 14th in DRS train battle - VelocityNews
item.description: Oscar Piastri won the Qatar F1 Sprint ahead of George Russell and Lando Norris, while Kiwi Liam Lawson finished 14th after battling in a tight DRS train.

item.title: Piastri seizes Qatar pole as Lawson falls short of Q3 in tight qualifying battle - VelocityNews
item.description: Oscar Piastri secured pole for the 2025 Qatar Grand Prix ahead of Lando Norris, while Kiwi Liam Lawson narrowly missed Q3. Full qualifying report and reaction.

item.title: Heartbreak for Feeney as Mostert claims title in wild Adelaide finale, Payne takes final race victory - VelocityNews
item.description: Chaz Mostert clinched the 2025 Supercars Championship in a dramatic Adelaide finale after Broc Feeney’s title bid collapsed in a controversial clash with Ryan Wood. Relive the decisive moments, the heartbreak, and the season-defining drama.

item.title: Norris under pressure after Verstappen Qatar victory; Lawson claims ninth - VelocityNews
item.description: Max Verstappen won the 2025 Qatar Grand Prix to slash Lando Norris’ championship lead, setting up a three-way title decider in Abu Dhabi as Liam Lawson scored ninth.

item.title: Giltrap out, Osborne third in thrilling Adelaide finale with two red flags - VelocityNews
item.description: Kiwi drivers Clay Osborne and Marco Giltrap faced a dramatic Carrera Cup Australia 2025 weekend. Osborne claimed a podium in Race 1 and top-10 finishes, while Giltrap’s weekend ended early after a Race 1 crash.

item.title: Hodson survives Super2 mayhem that sees seven DNFs - VelocityNews
item.description: Young Kiwi racer Ayrton Hodson battled collisions, mechanical failures, and wet conditions to finish the 2025 Super2 season, showing resilience in a chaotic final weekend.

item.title: Lawson secures 2026 F1 seat as Red Bull shake-up leaves Tsunoda’s future in doubt - VelocityNews
item.description: Liam Lawson secures his 2026 Formula 1 seat with Racing Bulls as Red Bull reshuffles its lineup, promoting Isack Hadjar and leaving Yuki Tsunoda’s future in doubt.

item.title: Rovanperä to begin single seater journey in New Zealand - VelocityNews
item.description: Kalle Rovanperä begins his single-seater career in New Zealand’s Castrol Toyota FR Oceania Trophy as he targets a Super Formula debut in 2026 after retiring from rallying.
